title: Lester on Lady Day
summary: Prez on why he loved Billie Holiday's singing.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: This is tape two of Jazz Oral History with Art Farmer. We’re talking about Lester.

Yeah, back to Lester. We were playing the Birdland one time, and there was a little, very young white lady playing or singing. She was not so good. I don’t know how she got the gig. Prez and I were sitting in a booth, and he said, “You know Prez, that’s why I dug Lady Day so much.” And I said, “Why?” “Because when she went to sing, she was not standing up there talking about ‘Look at me. I got a pussy.’ When she went to sing, she sang.” What he was saying was she wasn’t getting by on her sex appeal, she was just singing the song the way she felt it. That’s the way he felt about it. He said he really loved Lady Holiday.
Did she come around to the club? Did you meet her?
